findings.evidence: grep `ci-live\.js|liveStatus` in `code/` finds only `scripts/test_ci_live_browser.mjs:6` and `.github/workflows/ci-live-tests.yml:6,14`; no page references it. `ci-live.js:4-5`: `var root = document.querySelector("[data-ci-live]"); if (!root) return;`. `ci-live.js:7,47,140,187` holds the only manifest/`chartNote` chart-refresh code in `web/`.
findings.fix: Either move the chart-refresh code to a module that `CI.lean` loads on its own (a chart-specific script with its own mount, or into `ci-operations.js`) and delete the live-count code, or delete `ci-live.js` along with its test and workflow in the same PR. The test and workflow are under `scripts/` and `.github/`, so that part needs a human review.
findings.issue: The PR removes both the `<script src="static/ci-live.js">` tag and the `[data-ci-live]` mount from `web/Site/CI.lean`, so this module is unreferenced in `web/` and returns early. It is also the only home of the chart-refresh logic (`chartNote`, `/v1/ci/manifest.json` polling), which the PR says it preserves.

findings.evidence: The diff deletes `<section class="ci-live" ...>` from `web/Site/CI.lean`. grep `ci-live` in `web/` now matches only `style.css` and `ci-live.js`.
findings.fix: Remove the orphaned `.ci-live*` rules in the same PR. Keep `.ci-chart-age` only if chart refresh is moved to a module that is still loaded.
findings.issue: The `.ci-live`, `.ci-live-heading`, `.ci-live-counts`, `.ci-live-waiting` and `.ci-live-backlog` rules (497-522) style markup this PR deleted from `CI.lean`.

summary: Removing the live-count widget leaves `ci-live.js` and its `.ci-live*` CSS orphaned, and the chart-refresh logic that only exists in that script no longer loads despite the PR's claim to preserve it.
